description: The Federal Real Property Profile is the US government's inventory of federal civilian real property, managed by the Real Property Policy Division of the General Services Administration through the FRPP Management System. Under the Federal Assets Sale and Transfer Act, executive branch agencies, with some exceptions, must submit current data on all federal civilian real properties they own, lease or control, reported at the level of each constructed asset: land, buildings and other structures. The division runs the annual collection, coordinates with stakeholders and produces reports in the FRPP Summary Reports Library; owned and leased information has been combined in one report since fiscal year 2002. Coverage: federal civilian real property of executive branch agencies in the United States. Access: reports and data collection pages on GSA's site. Licence: US federal government information; free. Caveats: some agencies and sensitive assets are excepted, and the page read does not describe the fields of the public data release. Simulation uses are an inventory of government buildings for continuity-of-government exposure analysis and federal portfolio resilience planning. Related records: HIFLD Open.
